messages.content: 你能給我從舊金山家裡到帕羅奧圖辦公室最快的路線，然後從帕羅奧圖到舊金山金門大橋的風景路線，最後從金門大橋回家最快的路線嗎？

function.name: get_directions
function.description: Retrieve directions from one location to another. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting point of the journey.

end_location.description: The destination point of the journey.

route_type.description: Type of route to use (e.g., fastest, scenic). Default is fastest.

message.content:
Sure! To give you the most accurate routes, could you please share:

1. Your exact home address in San Francisco (or at least the street name and number).
2. The full address of the Palo Alto office you’ll be heading to.
3. Do you have a preferred spot on the Golden Gate Bridge (e.g., the visitor center, the south‑east corner, etc.) or would “Golden Gate Bridge” itself suffice?

Once I have those details, I’ll fetch the fastest route from home to the office, a scenic route from the office to the bridge, and finally the fastest route from the bridge back home.
